sentences.text: Blapl No.11558
Jagarnnath Sabar .... Petitioner

Mr. S. Mahunta, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha .... Opposite Party
Mr. P.K. Maharaj, Asc

CORAM: JUSTICE V. NARASINGH  ORDER 19.01.2023 Order No.
02. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
2. The Petitioner is an accused in C.T. Case No.15 of 2022 pending on the file of learned Addl.

Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge, Gunupur, arising out of Gunupur P.S. Case No.195 of 2021 for commission of the offence under Sections 376(2)(n)/312/341/323/506/34 IPC.
4.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s. 439 Cr.P.C by the learned Addl.
Sessions Judge, Gunupur, by order dated 11.07.2022 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.
5.

It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 09.12.2021 and as charge sheet has been filed on 27.10.2022, his further continuance in custody is not warranted.
6.
Learned counsel for the State opposes the prayer for bail.

7. Perused the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
8.
Considering the tenor thereof and filing of the charge sheet, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the learned court in seisin over the matter.
9. Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
